## Change

Describe the problem, resulting correction and affected study IDs or files.

## Source and evidence

Link the public source, report version and relevant page/section. Reference the review issue and any required maintainer decision. Distinguish metadata fixes from eligibility or identity changes.

## Validation

- [ ] Stable IDs retained; record versions and change ledger updated where applicable.
- [ ] Generated views and release manifest refreshed.
- [ ] Offline validation and publication tests pass.
- [ ] Dates, counts, citations and analysis descriptions remain consistent.
